gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: the ODF metadata family (record 0288) writes title, subject, description, author, lastModifiedBy, language and keywords; created, modified, revision, template, statistics and custom.<name> are refused

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: cell formatting is applied by naming an existing cell style (`style`); direct font, fill, border, alignment and number-format keys need an automatic-style author in the unified layer

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: an authored OpenFormula is stored inert with the cell's cached value (or none); the unified layer does not evaluate ODS formulas

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: a rename copies the table fragment under its new name and drops the original; the leaf refuses sheets with formulas, ranges, drawings, forms, protection or other dependency owners, and the writer refuses names a formula or named range still uses

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: the leaf moves only dependency-free worksheets: formulas, named/database/validation/print ranges, settings, scripts and tracked changes are refused; an added sheet placed before the end is moved the same way

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: rows are inserted, removed, moved and swapped through the leaf's logical row editor, which refuses formulas, merges, ranges, validations, drawings, annotations and other coordinate owners on the worksheet

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: inserting or removing a column that shifts cells needs a logical column editor the leaf does not have

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: row height and visibility, and column width and visibility, live in automatic styles the unified writer does not author yet

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: a named range's scope is fixed once added; named expressions are retargeted through `ref` and are not added

gaps.subject: operation
gaps.reason: flat single-XML spreadsheets (.fods) are edited through the leaf's packaged projection and republished element by element (record 0292); an edit that adds a package member or changes a part's root has no flat form and is refused, as is a projection the packaged reader refuses

gaps.subject: operation
